reports.title: Core Natural Resources Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: “While mining conditions can and will vary from quarter to quarter, the Core team remains laser-focused on achieving world-class productivity and industry-leading cost performance on a sustained basis across our entire mining portfolio, while operating in tight alignment with our core values of safety and compliance, continuous improvement, and financial performance,” said Mitesh Thakkar, Core’s president. “With our strategically diversified operating platform, Core is uniquely positioned to capitalize on what we view as the highest potential market opportunities in the coal universe — tightening global energy markets, an ongoing infrastructure build-out in the developing world, and resurgent U.S. power demand.”
